entries.en: Auto-background long-running bash commands instead of killing them. Customize with BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.zh: 自动在后台运行长时间运行的 bash 命令而不是终止它们。使用 BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS 进行自定义

entries.en: Fixed a bug where Haiku was unnecessarily called in print mode
entries.zh: 修复了在打印模式下不必要地调用俳句的错误
